name: pore-analysis
description: Measure porosity, pore size/shape, lattice period and ordering (psi6, Voronoi coordination, radial g(r) and orientational correlation length) from top-view SEM images of porous films such as anodic aluminium oxide. The agent reads the image to calibrate and crop; a Python core does the morphometry and flags results that contradict physics. Vision decides, Python computes — no hardcoded autodetect, so it adapts to different instruments and scale-bar formats.
